hero.heading: Shred A Billion Beginner Guide: Controls, First Steps, and Upgrades
hero.lead: The Shred A Billion beginner guide starts with a simple route: collect bills with your hand vac, feed them to the shredder, and use the coins to upgrade as you dig deeper. The Roblox listing names backpack vacs, the Mega Vac, and the Black Hole as later tools, and warns that monsters come out at night. It also describes finding a golden key to open the gold vault. The sections below separate confirmed early goals from features that need checking in your own version, then give a practical first-session checklist and explain what the listing confirms about co-op and progression.

sections.heading: Collect Bills, Shred Them for Coins, and Dig Toward the Gold Vault
sections.intro: In Shred A Billion, picking up bills is only the first half of earning coins. Start with the hand vac, then take the cash you collect to the shredder. Each bundle pays out coins when you shred it. Those coins fund tool upgrades, so if you're working toward a better vacuum, focus on turning the cash you've already gathered into coins.
paragraphs: As you upgrade your tools, keep digging for the golden key. The key opens the gold vault; it isn't something you buy with the coins from shredding. Finding it changes what you’re working on: instead of collecting more bills for the shredder, your next job is to get the gold out.

Once the vault is open, load the gold onto carts and take it to the hideout. That delivery is the next objective after opening the door. If you're looking for where to play or want a quick orientation before your first run, start with the Shred A Billion Wiki.
